title: Commander Wahli (Zaishen quest)
wikitext: {{Quest infobox | id =1037 | name = Commander Wahli | section = Zaishen Bounty | image = [[File:Commander Wahli.jpg|250px]] | given by =[[Zaishen Bounty]] | given at =[[Great Temple of Balthazar]] | map = [[File:Commander Wahli map.jpg|250px]] | map1text = Commander Wahli Location }}__NOTOC__ Kill [[Commander Wahli]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Kill Commander Wahli in the [[Barbarous Shore]]. * *BONUS* Kill Commander Wahli in [[Hard Mode]]. * See [[Zehnchu]] [[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 1,000 [[Experience]] * 500 [[Gold]] * 100 [[Sunspear Promotion Points]] * Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]]. * Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins. ==Walkthrough== There are several [[patrol]]s along the way a few can be avoided, watch out for overlapping patrols. Commander Wahli is surrounded by a huge [[mob]], be prepared to retreat if overwhelmed especially in hard mode. If you resurrect, be careful as another group (including a Corsair boss) patrols very near the closest [[resurrection shrine]] to Wahli. Of the three routes shown on the [[:File:Commander Wahli map.jpg|map to the right]], the '''blue''' path has some easily avoidable Heket groups and later a few plant and elemental groups. The '''red''' path avoids most of the Corsair bosses, but does include a significant number of elemental foes. The Corsair bosses patrol fairly close together on the '''yellow''' path, but can be carefully [[pull]]ed apart. ==Dialogues== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Zaishen Bounty :''"Kill Commander Wahli in the Barbarous Shore."'' {{offer dialogue |accept = I can do that! |decline = No, I'm way too busy today. |ask = This despicable villain still stalks the land, preying on the innocent. Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.}} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Zehnchu :''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."'' [[Category:Rewards Sunspear promotion points]]
